source.role: Behavioral reference only; implementation is not copied

profile: Native regular files, explicit LC_ALL/LANG/POSIXLY_CORRECT environments, file-backed stdin except separately labeled pipe case; stdout/stderr captured as raw base64 without normalization
shellProfile: Root GNU 3.7 native redirection experiment, exact unnormalized expected triples; file-backed redirections and actual pipeline must remain distinct. These are required regressions, not excluded cases. Consumed-byte, descriptor-alias, transparent env invocation, default 4096-byte block and seekable shared-stdin cases captured independently with /bin/bash --noprofile --norc, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin and LC_ALL=C. All shell cases are required, including the native duplicate-close EBADF.

rawArgumentCapture.profile: Bash ANSI-C raw byte argv; regular files including literal U+FFFD; C locale; stdin /dev/null; raw stdout/stderr base64

unicodeArgumentCapture.profile: Existing Unicode, BOM, astral and U+FFFD regular filenames; both operand orders; C and C.UTF-8; all output modes; raw stdout/stderr base64

unicodeNullOutputCapture.profile: Unicode/BOM filenames with real stdout /dev/null; first mismatch versus EOF; raw stdout/stderr base64
